# Conformance fixture assets

These files are copied from the MIT-licensed `diegomura/react-pdf` test suite at reference commit `d41a8207fb06a56e60fcb53ac0e18ce27e7d32d6` so the paired React/Vue fixture uses local, repeatable inputs.

- `Roboto-Regular.ttf` is the upstream `packages/layout/tests/assets/font.ttf` fixture. Its embedded metadata identifies it as Roboto Regular, Copyright 2011 Google Inc.
- `sample.png` is the upstream `packages/layout/tests/assets/test.png` fixture.

They are test-only and are not included in the published package.
